context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 216ag Brand Inheritance into Outbound Channels verified: (1) Backend _branding_for_member() helper in studio_billing.py resolves site-scoped branding for invoice emails/PDFs. (2) Invoice send path (POST /api/memberships/billing/invoices/{id}/send) uses site branding - no 500s from resolver. (3) SVC auto-notify (_maybe_send_auto_transition_email in svc/comms.py) includes org_name, brand_primary_color, brand_logo_url from site branding when case.site_id is set. (4) Site branding override regression from iter 216af passes - GET/PATCH /api/sites/{id}/branding, _inherits flags, public /m/{slug}/branding?site= path. (5) Frontend SiteBrandingOverride.js has BrandPreview component with data-testid='site-branding-preview-{siteId}' that shows live preview of member portal header + Pay button using draft values. (6) Preview updates LIVE when typing in primary_color input (no save required). (7) Clearing a field shows parent org's value in preview (fall-through inheritance). NOTE: Invoice send tests skipped because test members have no billable items - the key verification is that the send endpoint doesn't 500 from the branding resolver. MOCKED: Resend email transport is unset in preview env - tests accept HTTP 502 as proof of successful rendering + attempted delivery.
